question: Does any Optic Accessory (SCA) choice change a stat the site displays, and are any site values taken from SCA-gated source objects?
method: Resolve every *_Ability.xml Class_74f6b9e4 entry whose progression is U_PRG_*_SCA_* to its branch selectors (355 entries).
List effects imported by the shared WPM_SCA_* parts; decode inline Class_104c2294, Class_2fea847d and Class_2f74f085 values.
For each U_WPM_SCA_* selector GUID, find GS_* bindings (Struct_97a87294 Field_6d011165 -> Field_2f0e5b83) across 64 GS files and weapon-body Class_897c99a7 parts listing it in Field_819acc98.

Tabulate every weapon-body Class_2fea847d / Class_28d25398 object with its Field_e77336c8 value, Field_90fd0310 weapon-sway multiplier and the named selectors of every part that references it; match the multipliers against data/attachments.json.

optics.gsBindings: SCA selectors bind only GCR_* camera-recoil modifiers in all 64 GS files (e.g. CantedIronSights -> GCR_Variable_1x50_P00 on 63, OffsetRedDot -> GCR_Variable_1x00_P00 on 63, Variable 2x/3x/4x -> GCR_Variable_*_P00 on 62). Camera recoil is a known unmodeled case.
optics.sharedParts: WPM_SCA_* import only visual/zoom assets (VE_*, Zoom_*_PiP, 1_5xZoom), WeaponLensFlareData_*_AG (AGCoating) and WME_HighZoom_Magnifier_P00.
optics.inlineAdsField: Class_104c2294 Field_9540bd8e is 16 on canted irons and Variable 2x/3x/4x, 0 on canted/offset red dots, 24 on WPM_G43Magnifier; ordinary optic parts carry 8-72 in the same field while WME_ADSTime_FOV_* carry +/-1. Treated as an unresolved optic setting, not an ADS tier step.
optics.inlineOpticSway: Class_2fea847d with Field_e77336c8=1 on 51 optic WPM_SCP_* parts is neutral (1 on 45; 0.999002-0.999004 on 6), consistent with L62.
optics.unresolved: Class_bfd4f199 1.1 triplets on 10 CantedRedDot weapon-body parts and the Variable_Any inline classes (83584c75, 87421347, c42bd53b, daaa7328) are unnamed.

captureCheck.question: Do the unconditional iron-gated locals act as general ADS sway multipliers?
captureCheck.result: Both weapons fit the shared iron package alone and not the local iron multipliers. This supports reading weapon-body sway locals as sight-state data rather than general multipliers; it does not directly measure the canted-gated objects.
